name: Power Word Petrify
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature with 100 hp or less
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter a single word of power that causes the target to instantly turn to stone, permanently becoming petrified. The target does not need to hear or understand the word. Any creature that currently has 101 or more hit points is unaffected by power word petrify.
